items.title: 1.10 Wi-Fi Security and Router Configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Wi-Fi Security and Router Configuration' (PDF 17): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Wi-Fi security network ko unauthorized access (baghair ijazat istemal) se bachati hai. Security ke baghair koi bhi internet istemal kar sakta hai. Hackers unsecured (baghair hifazat wale) networks se personal (zaati) maloomat chura sakte hain. Secure Wi-Fi data ko mehfooz aur private (raaz mein) rakhta hai. Yeh internet ki speed slow hone se bhi bachata hai. Strong (mazboot) security poore network ki performance behtar karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Wi-Fi par security na ho to teen nuqsan kya ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Koi bhi internet istemal kar sakta hai (speed slow), hackers zaati maloomat chura sakte hain, aur data mehfooz aur private nahi rehta.

items: Wi-Fi security: baghair ijazat istemal rokti, data mehfooz aur private rakhti, speed aur performance behtar.
